creatures.name: Dragon, Metallic, Silver, Young

special_abilities.name: Change Shape
special_abilities.description: A silver dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form three times per day as if using polymorph.

special_abilities.name: Cloudwalking
special_abilities.description: A very young or older silver dragon can tread on clouds or fog as though on solid ground.

special_abilities.name: Graceful Flight
special_abilities.description: A young or older silver dragon's aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

special_abilities.name: Paralyzing Breath
special_abilities.description: Instead of a cone of cold, a silver dragon can breathe a cone of paralyzing gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.

tables.name: Dragon, Silver — Age Category
rows: Change shape, cold subtype, immune to acid, paralyzing breath

creatures.ecology: Of all the dragons, silvers are the most courageous, holding themselves to a chivalrous code to help the weak, defeat evil, and behave in an honorable manner. A silver dragon can cast cleric spells as arcane spells.

special_abilities.name: Cloudwalking

special_abilities.name: Cold Aura
special_abilities.description: An old or older silver dragon is surrounded by an aura of cold. All creatures within 5 feet of the dragon take 1d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of the dragon's turn. An ancient dragon's aura extends to 10 feet. A great wyrm's aura damage increases to 2d6. A silver dragon can suppress or activate this aura at will as a free action.

special_abilities.name: Fog Vision
special_abilities.description: A juvenile or older silver dragon can see perfectly well in fog and clouds.

special_abilities.name: Graceful Flight
special_abilities.description: A young or older silver dragon's aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

special_abilities.name: Paralyzing Breath
special_abilities.description: Instead of a cone of cold, a silver dragon can breathe a cone of paralyzing gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.

special_abilities.name: Reflective Scales
special_abilities.description: Any spell that targets an ancient or older silver dragon but fails to penetrate the silver dragon's spell resistance might be reflected. If the caster level check to penetrate the dragon's spell resistance is failed by 5 or more, the spell is reflected. If the check fails by 4 or less, the spell is merely wasted. This otherwise functions as spell turning.
